## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_15m),last_1h):avg:synthetics.browser.page_load{__SCOPE__} by {service} > 40
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-web-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-app-health` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `query_recent_errors`, `fetch_deploy_history`, `fetch_dependency_map`.

Attached to the alert automatically: error samples, last 3 deploys, dependency health summary.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
